actions: Read the five highest-leverage wiki concept notes on skill triggering, description-as-trigger, and the Pocock authoring rubric
Audited all 96 skill descriptions mechanically against the rubric: 38,084 description bytes of permanent context load, 4 missing version fields, 5 SKILL.md files over 20,000 bytes
Tested the hypothesis that .serena/memories should be scanned for orphan references and falsified it: 182 findings, 136 unique entities, effectively all false positives
workLog.outcome: One hypothesis falsified with evidence, one live defect located

actions: Confirmed orphan-ref-validator returned CRITICAL_FAIL on clean main with 49 findings, and that /build Gate 4 and /test Gate 5 both reject on that verdict
Root-caused it: SKILL_REF_RE treats any backticked kebab-case token as a skill reference, with precision supplied only by a hand-curated denylist that grew one token per bot-review round
Added sibling-namespace resolution plus an asymmetric strict path for prose that explicitly types a token as a skill, preserving REQ-009 AC-2
Ran two adversarial review rounds against a different model; accepted a blocker with executable evidence in round 1 and three of five findings in round 2
Pushed back on one round-2 finding with measured counter-evidence: the proposed inversion reintroduces every original false positive
workLog.outcome: 49 findings to 28, 95 tests passing. The 26 remaining script_path findings are true orphans and are left for a separate change

actions: Verified that the orchestrator Agent Capability Matrix listed a memory agent that does not exist; memory is a skill
Cross-checked the full 18-row matrix against the 30-file agent roster and confirmed memory was the only phantom
Removed the row from the canonical template and all five generated or hand-maintained copies, and added roster-verification guidance
Found the same phantom in the README agent table and removed it there
workLog.outcome: Silent routing failure removed from every copy of the orchestrator

actions: User reported that docs/agent-catalog.md does not ship with the registered plugin, so plugin-shipped content must be self-contained
Verified the boundary from both marketplace manifests: only .claude/, src/claude/, and src/copilot-cli/ ship
Measured the blast radius: 3,804 outbound path references from inside the three plugin roots across 538 tracked files
Confirmed a live instance: docs/agent-catalog.md is referenced from ai-agents-generation-and-release in two plugin roots
Wrote .claude/rules/plugin-self-containment.md, regenerated both instruction mirrors, and recorded decision-plugin-roots-ship-alone in Serena
workLog.outcome: The boundary is now binding knowledge in the rule tree and the memory graph rather than tacit

actions: Pre-commit failed because .venv was not a valid Python environment
Root cause: 657 MB of scratch from a prior PR review had been parked inside .venv/, displacing the interpreter
Moved the scratch out of the repository rather than deleting it, then ran uv sync
workLog.outcome: uv run resolves the pinned Python 3.14.6 again; tests run under uv rather than falling back to system python3

nextSteps: Land the 26 script_path true orphans, which is what actually turns the gate green
Consider an automated gate for plugin self-containment; the rule currently has no enforcement
Work the remaining wiki gaps, starting with agents inferring context pressure from self-observation
